title: Code for: When to Ask and When to Refer: Fairness-Audited Reinforcement Learning for Depression Screening
description: Colab notebooks and result files for a simulation study in which a tabular Q-learning agent decides, step by step, whether to stop, ask one more item, or refer a respondent to a counselor in depression screening, with a fairness audit across age groups. Data come from the Open-Source Psychometrics Project and are not redistributed.
